lines.beaver_en: Welcome. How can I help you?
lines.en: Hello. I came to send a parcel.

lines.beaver: 네, 소포 안에 뭐가 들어 있어요?
lines.beaver_roman: Ne, sopo ane mwoga deureo isseoyo?
lines.en: It's a birthday gift for a friend. A new phone.
To Busan. I'll also mail a postcard.

lines.beaver_en: Will you write the postcard now?
lines.en: No, I'll write it after sending the parcel.

lines.beaver_en: Okay. Do you need an envelope too?
lines.learner: 네, 엽서를 넣을 봉투 하나 주세요.
lines.en: Yes, one envelope for the postcard, please.
lines.roman: Ne, yeopseoreul neoeul bongtu hana juseyo.

lines.beaver_en: Here you go. Please write your contact info.
lines.en: I wrote my phone number and email address.

lines.beaver_en: Thank you. The parcel arrives in two days.
lines.learner: 소포가 도착한 후에 연락을 받을 수 있어요?
lines.en: Can I get a message after it arrives?
lines.roman: Sopoga dochakan hue yeollageul badeul su isseoyo?

lines.beaver: 네, 문자로 연락이 가요. 엽서도 다 쓰셨어요?
lines.beaver_en: Yes, you'll get a text. Did you finish the postcard?
lines.beaver_roman: Ne, munjaro yeollagi gayo. Yeopseodo da sseusyeosseoyo?
lines.learner: 네, 다 썼어요. 같이 부쳐 주세요.
lines.en: Yes, I finished it. Please send it together.
lines.roman: Ne, da sseosseoyo. Gachi buchyeo juseyo.

lines.en: Here you are. That was faster than last time.
Thank you. Have a good day.
